translations.web: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
translations.bsb: Was a man already circumcised when he was called? He should not become uncircumcised. Was a man still uncircumcised when called? He should not be circumcised.
translations.kjv: Is ➔ any man called being circumcised? let him ➔ not become uncircumcised. Is ➔ any called in uncircumcision? let him ➔ not be circumcised.
translations.asv: Was any man called being circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Hath any been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
